acl_misconfig.reason: The benchmark ground truth identifies an ACL rule or binding on the affected SONiC device as the fault.
resolution: Correct or remove the unintended ACL rule or interface binding on the affected device.

verification.expected_result: The unintended ACL is absent or corrected.

bgp_neighbor_misconfig.reason: The benchmark ground truth identifies the affected device's BGP neighbor configuration as the fault.
resolution: Correct the BGP neighbor parameters on the affected SONiC device.

verification.expected_result: The affected BGP session is Established with the intended peer parameters.

blackhole_route.reason: The benchmark ground truth identifies a discard route on the affected device as the fault.
resolution: Remove or correct the unintended discard route on the affected SONiC device.

verification.expected_result: The intended forwarding route is selected instead of a discard route.
Reachability through the affected path is restored.

device_down.reason: The benchmark ground truth identifies the target SONiC device as unavailable.
resolution: Restore the affected SONiC device and its network services.

verification.expected_result: The device responds and expected interfaces report operational state.
Paths through the restored device recover.

high_latency.reason: The benchmark ground truth identifies excessive delay on the affected interface.
resolution: Remove the unintended delay impairment or repair the affected link.

verification.expected_result: Latency on paths using the affected link returns to the expected range.

link_down.reason: The benchmark ground truth identifies the affected interface as down.
resolution: Restore or enable the affected link and correct the underlying physical or administrative condition.

verification.expected_result: The affected interface is administratively and operationally up.
Traffic paths using the link recover.

link_flapping.reason: The benchmark ground truth identifies repeated state changes on the affected interface.
resolution: Stabilize the affected link and remove the condition causing repeated state transitions.

verification.expected_result: The interface remains up without new flap events.

mtu_mismatch.reason: The benchmark ground truth identifies an inconsistent MTU on the affected interface.
resolution: Configure a consistent intended MTU across the affected path.

verification.expected_result: The affected interface reports the intended MTU.

verification.command: ping_test with the intended DF payload
verification.expected_result: Large packets traverse the path successfully.

packet_corruption.reason: The benchmark ground truth identifies packet corruption on the affected interface.
resolution: Remove the corruption impairment or repair the affected link and transceiver path.

verification.expected_result: Error and corruption indicators stop increasing.
End-to-end traffic returns to the expected quality.

packet_loss.reason: The benchmark ground truth identifies packet loss on the affected interface.
resolution: Remove the loss impairment or repair the affected link.

verification.expected_result: Packet loss returns to the expected range.

route_policy_misconfig.reason: The benchmark ground truth identifies a route policy on the affected device as the fault.
resolution: Correct the route policy and its BGP attachment on the affected SONiC device.

verification.expected_result: Expected prefixes pass policy and are installed for forwarding.

static_route_misconfig.reason: The benchmark ground truth identifies an incorrect static route on the affected device.
resolution: Correct or remove the unintended static route on the affected SONiC device.

verification.expected_result: The destination resolves through the intended next hop.
